module_summary: Moore FSM modeling a Lemming with walk, fall, dig and dead states, plus a saturating fall-duration counter that decides splatter on landing.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Seven-state controller register: walk, fall, dig per direction, and dead

anchors.name: fall_counter
anchors.why: Counts falling cycles, saturates at 20, triggers DEAD on landing

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Decoded output high in WL state

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Decoded output high in WR state

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Decoded output high in either falling state

anchors.name: digging
anchors.why: Decoded output high in either digging state

anchors.name: dig
anchors.why: Dig command moving walking lemming into dig state

groups.name: Lemming controller
groups.description: Next-state logic on ground, dig, bumps and fall count

groups.name: Fall timer
groups.description: Saturating counter of cycles spent falling
